parameters.content:
## Lead Agent Evaluation
Runs the 20 test leads through the Lead Qualification Agent, one lead every 15 seconds, and compares the tier with the expected tier.

Why 15 seconds: the Groq free tier allows 8,000 tokens per minute, and one lead uses about 1,400.

After importing: open **Run agent on each lead** and select your **Lead Qualification Agent** workflow.

Eval runs stop after Combine results, so no approvals, emails or log rows are created.
